 Championship 
 We are starting to get back under way for the second half in the three early games.
 More goals please.

 get involved Get Involved published at 13:32 GMT 13:32 GMT 
 HT: Millwall 0-1 QPR 
 It was definitely a goal for QPR. And after the ref didn't give a stonewall penalty against them, Millwall fans should be thanking the ref, not booing him
 Hadrian - Coventry 
 1 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:26 GMT 13:26 GMT 
 HT: Norwich 0-0 Cardiff 
 Rob Newman 
Former Norwich defender on BBC Radio Norfolk 
 Cardiff have shown their intent, they want to go forward when they have the ball.
 They might want to push their back four up a bit higher.
 10 6 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:23 GMT 13:23 GMT 
 HT: Norwich 0-0 Cardiff 
 Chris Goreham 
BBC Radio Norfolk commentator 
 Cardiff finished the half the stronger.
 Both managers will be happy enough with the performances so far.
 26 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HALF-TIME published at 13:20 GMT 13:20 GMT 
 Millwall 0-1 QPR 
 Boos from the home crowd as the first half comes to an end.
 Player sent off, then a somewhat controversial goal given against them just a moment ago - it's fair to say referee Josh Smith isn't a popular man in Bermondsey right now.
 80 17 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HALF-TIME published at 13:17 GMT 13:17 GMT 
 Southampton 0-0 Derby 
 Image source, Press Association Nothing doing.
 The home side had much the better of the opening exchanges and returning striker Cyle Larin hit the bar from close in.
 However, they've rather run out of steam and ideas a little and Derby ended the half the better, with Carlton Morris' dipping effort forcing a fine save from Daniel Peretz just before the interval.
 Intriguing if not gripping stuff.
 61 48 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HALF-TIME published at 13:16 GMT 13:16 GMT 
 Norwich 0-0 Cardiff 
 Image source, Getty Images Despite a combined total of 37 goals in the past four games involving Norwich and Cardiff, we are goalless at the break at Carrow Road. 
 Good game for a 0-0 so far though. Both sides have played some nice football, Rubin Colwill has struck the bar for the Bluebirds and the Canaries have threatened as well. 
 Surely this won’t end in a stalemate? Right? 
 52 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:16 GMT 13:16 GMT 
 Norwich 0-0 Cardiff 
 Just the one minute added on at the end of the first half at Carrow Road.
 10 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL: Millwall 0-1 QPR published at 13:16 GMT 13:16 GMT 
 Nico Madsen (45+1 mins) 
 Rangers make the breakthrough on the stroke of half-time!
 Ilias Chair turns inside the box and forces a block from Lukas Jensen, then Nico Madsen thunders the rebound towards goal and it looks as though Mark Sykes' heroics have kept the ball from crossing the line.
 But the linesman deems otherwise, the goal is given and that's a great way for Madsen to mark his return from injury!
 247 51 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:14 GMT 13:14 GMT 
 Southampton 0-0 Derby 
 Great effort from Carlton Morris from the edge of the area and Daniel Peretz does fantastically to tip it over the bar.
 The away side looking threatening now.
 73 33 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 13:13 GMT 13:13 GMT 
 Southampton 0-0 Derby 
 Why are the shadows at St Mary's so long in the middle of the day?
 Nick - London 
 We really need a goal to talk about. Somewhere. Anywhere. 
 44 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:12 GMT 13:12 GMT 
 Millwall 0-0 QPR 
 Good little spell for Millwall as Casper de Norre's ball into the box is scrambled behind by Richard Kone and that gives the home side the opportunity to put QPR under pressure from a corner.
 The visitors bring the ball downfield again, though, and it needs Caleb Taylor to be alert and scramble the ball behind as Kone powers into the six-yard box.
 14 12 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:12 GMT 13:12 GMT 
 Southampton 0-0 Derby 
 The away side's first shot.
 David Ozoh wins the ball really well on the halfway line and feeds the rapid Mo Fuseini down the right but he drags his effort well wide.
 24 8 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 PENALTY APPEAL published at 13:12 GMT 13:12 GMT 
 Norwich 0-0 Cardiff 
 Anthony Musaba goes down in the box for Norwich and wants a penalty but he basically just ran into Cardiff defender Krystian Bielik.
 Nothing doing.
 37 24 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:09 GMT 13:09 GMT 
 Norwich 0-0 Cardiff 
 Rob Newman 
Former Norwich defender on BBC Radio Norfolk 
 As 0-0s go it has been entertaining, there has been a lack of quality in the final third particularly, but play between the two boxes has been impressive.
 36 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:07 GMT 13:07 GMT 
 Southampton 0-0 Derby 
 The away side just growing into this a little now.
 A couple of openings have come to nothing after heavy touches from striker Carlton Morris and then Bobby Clark's clever reverse pass almost plays Jack Robinson in.
 The strugglers have maybe just weathered the Saints storm and are looking to throw some punches of their own.
 Image source, Press Association 
 53 50 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:07 GMT 13:07 GMT 
 Norwich 0-0 Cardiff 
 Rob Newman 
Former Norwich defender on BBC Radio Norfolk 
 They need more Norwich players coming into the box, midfield players making late runs into the area.
 16 10 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:06 GMT 13:06 GMT 
 Norwich 0-0 Cardiff 
 Chris Willock digs out a cross from the left for Cardiff and Yousef Salech gets a head on it but can't find the target.
 25 6 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:05 GMT 13:05 GMT 
 Millwall 0-0 QPR 
 It might be inaccurate to say Alex Neil is pleased with the way things have gone so far, but he'll be happy with his side's solidity since the exit of Zak Sturge.
 The plan is to get men behind the ball and challenge QPR to break them down - and so far, it's worked.
 Camiel Neghli has dropped in at left-back to fill the gap left by Sturge.
 16 8 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:05 GMT 13:05 GMT 
 Norwich 0-0 Cardiff 
 Anthony Musaba is trying to make something happen for Norwich and he drives powerfully in from the left.
 Musaba gets a shot away but it's well blocked by the Cardiff backline.
 Good game, no goal yet.
